name: 书剑天下（小熊泥苑分站）
english_name: Book and Sword Under Heaven (Little Bear Branch)
english_description: Self-titled "Book and Sword Under Heaven," like shujian2008, this is a branch deployed by the "Little Bear Mud Garden" (dtxy.126.com) site. Its source is nearly identical to shujian2008's — two independent deployments of the same game on different servers.
